def plus_weekly(r):
    old=c(r,1)['symbol'];c(r,1)['symbol']='VX+1/V6'
    for quote in f(r)['quotes']:
        if quote['symbol']==old:quote['symbol']='VX+1/V6'

def run(r):
    body=json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)
    a=subprocess.run([str(ROOT/'rust/target/debug/options-core')],input=body+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    b=subprocess.run([str(ROOT/'zenquant'),'evaluate','--route','/api/vix/evaluate'],input=body,capture_output=True,text=True)
    return json.loads(a.stdout),json.loads(b.stdout)['report'] if b.returncode==0 else {'error':b.stderr.strip()}
def same(a,b):
    if 'error' in a:
        normalize=lambda s:''.join(c for c in s.lower() if c.isalpha())
        return normalize(a['error'])==normalize(b.get('error',''))
    return a==b
results=[]
for name,r in CASES:
    a,b=run(r); results.append({'name':name,'same':same(a,b),'rust':a,'go':b})
print('core cases:',len(results),'matching:',sum(x['same'] for x in results))
for item in results:
    if not item['same']:print(json.dumps(item))
(ROOT/'core-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
